test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

Sohan is __the older__ brother __of my best__ friend.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "elder" should be used instead of "older" when referring to **siblings.**
 
• In this sentence, "Sohan is the elder brother" is the correct form.
 
• Using "elder" emphasizes the relationship of age among siblings.
 
• Therefore, the correct word here is elder.

Hence, the correct statement should be '***Sohan is the elder brother__ of my best friend'*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The word "older" is used generally to **compare the age of people or things.**
 
• The word "elder" is specifically used for comparing the **age of people,** particularly **among family members.**
 
• When referring to someone who is more advanced in age within the same family, "elder" is the appropriate term.
